changes: 💬 Chat window is now noticeably taller (was capped at 72vh/560px, now 88vh/720px) — fixes content getting cut off, especially images.

🔔 New: a push notification now goes out when someone posts in Group Chat — previously only @mentions triggered a push, so a regular message (even with a photo) never notified anyone who wasn't already looking. Rate-limited per recipient (one notification per 5 minutes even during an active back-and-forth) so it can't spam, and skips anyone already specifically @mentioned in the same message so they don't get double-pinged.

✨ Premium polish pass: deeper shadows on message bubbles, a richer header gradient, a recessed/glowing input field, a proper press-and-glow send button, and refined image styling with its own shadow and border.
